summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and system group inventory-readers, then chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers and set dirs to 750 / files to 640 across the tree, preserving existing file contents. Verified via inspection, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy pre-restart baseline (boot_id, ownership/perms, file contents), issued a native reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and re-verified ownership, permissions, group readability, and unchanged file contents post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory and confirmed absence of inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group (cmd-ebcadee11d8044c2)

Created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc; chown -R and chmod (dirs 750, files 640) applied to /srv/inventory; verified perms and unchanged file contents (cmd-1cb9a192ec1841a6)
Verified inventorysvc uid/gid and inventory-readers gid via id/getent (cmd-35577b7debe5496c)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, directory perms (cmd-584574ff187244fd), and file-level perms/contents via sudo sh -c stat/cat (cmd-c69ea6fd84bb4644)
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via sudo -n so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection (cmd-54c354cd67254538)
Confirmed node1 was unreachable immediately after the restart command (cmd-679a5a663ccc41a7)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again and captured new boot_id/uptime proving the restart occurred (cmd-7dbccbc4644b4799)
Re-verified post-restart ownership, permissions, file contents, and inventorysvc/inventory-readers identities (cmd-ada4ff1aa02d4e47)

evidence.requirement: Existing data in /srv/inventory owned by inventorysvc, group-readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to others, with contents preserved
evidence.summary: Baseline showed root:root 755/644 with no inventorysvc user or inventory-readers group. After creating the user/group and applying chown + chmod (750 dirs / 640 files), ls/stat show inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership with no 'other' permission bits, and records.csv/config.json content is byte-identical to the original.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229 captured alongside healthy ownership/perms/content of /srv/inventory. A backgrounded 'sudo shutdown -r now' returned its acknowledgement before the node dropped (confirmed unreachable in the next call). Polling later succeeded with a new boot_id dc308602-8027-499d-a591-ebeb571a79f6, proving an actual restart. Post-restart checks confirm inventorysvc/inventory-readers still exist and /srv/inventory retains correct ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), permissions (750/640), and unmodified file contents.
